questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
Which font do you use for headlines? (it sets the hook label)
The main font file (bold weight), found on your computer.
A regular or medium weight of the main font, if you have one.
Captions in the same main font, or a different one?
The caption font file, if different from the main font.
Your off-white (used for the thin light rim round the cut-out), if your brand guide has one.
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (most accurate, about $0.22 per hour) or on this computer (free)?
Where should finished videos go?
Is your raw footage on an external drive? Which one?
Where do you keep music you are allowed to use?
Should I always ask before adding music, or add a favourite and tell you which?
Where do you keep your own images and real material I can use in the grid?
How big should the captions on your chest be? 46 px keeps a four-to-six word line about as wide as your chest.
Letter spacing of the captions, in em (negative is tighter). -0.045 suits a clean sans; use 0 for a wide or script font.
How wide should you appear in the centre, in pixels of the 1080 frame? 540 is head to chest at medium size.
Should the opening carry a text hook on a white label across the top images?
May I search the web for the images (stock and print-shop sites filtered out, every source listed in my report), or use only your own material?
questions.default: yes: web search, every source listed in the report

questions.ask: Is there anything that must never be shown in the grid: people, brands, competitors, topics?
